metadata.title: Investigate MLC LLM compiled Metal artifact/schema, Apple target and pinned TVM module/storage/stream contracts, and compile/runtime KV limits without confusing canonical metadata, codegen or automatic estimates with runnable native model qualification.

applicability.scope: Selected artifact/Apple target/pinned TVM Metal consumer and KV configuration source contracts. Common catalog categorization is not CPU inference or Apple qualification.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the pinned MLC and exact TVM fork/gitlink contracts; native checks require separately prepared matching MLC/TVM/FFI and the applicable Apple SDK/device stack.
applicability.input_contract: MLC revision, TVM gitlink/build, model/tokenizer/quantized-parameter identity, target/host/SDK, compiled artifact/format, runtime device and the actual compiled/runtime configuration sources.
applicability.produced_artifact: An identity and actual-versus-declared boundary report for artifact, Metal runtime or KV-limit ownership, with a negative signal and smallest missing native discriminator.
applicability.failure_modes: Treating a schema hash as payload authentication, an opt-in WebLLM artifact contract as a native-engine ABI, serializable Metal fallback as runnable, or automatic capacity estimates as free memory can create unsupported qualification claims.

limitations: Source-derived candidate; original compiled CPU/native tests, compiler/live API/CLI/model/Metal/fit/quality/service/performance execution not_run; required native BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND.
Opt-in artifact manifest first targets WebLLM; native engine ignoring that ABI is not qualified by canonical metadata agreement.
Serializable kind=metal fallback can be non-runnable; codegen/export/pipeline/submission and actual load/dispatch/completion differ.

Helpers screen narrow explicit canonical metadata, literal target strings or limit clamping only; no general Pydantic/TVM emulation, actual tensor/weight/export authentication or GPU/memory simulation.
Full model/tokenizer/quantization/VLM/RNN/speculation/disaggregation/CUDA/scheduler/dependency implementation and broad skill efficacy remain outside selected contracts.
NO_LICENSE is unavailable machine SPDX metadata, not legal absence; both source owners Apache LICENSE/NOTICE bytes are independently retained.
Checkout-only local skill; no automatic execution or promotion.
Only declared references are required; other cross-skill links are navigation.
Historical revisions require a matching checkout or a retained store.
